neighbours.label: ' person' (also ' man', ' people') right after a universal or negative quantifier: 'any person', 'no person', 'every person'
fire: The law says no person shall be held without a fair trial.
Honestly, any person with a library card can borrow these books.
She remembered the name of every person she had ever met.
In this club, no person is more important than the team.
The guide said any man could climb the hill in an hour.
Under the rules, every person on board must wear a life jacket.
He insisted that no person had entered the room after midnight.
Almost any person can learn to swim with a good teacher.
quiet: The law says the accused shall be held only after a fair trial.
Honestly, the person at the front desk was very helpful today.
She remembered the name of the teacher she had first met.
In this club, the captain is more important than the coach.
The guide said a tourist could climb the hill in an hour.
Under the rules, each passenger on board must wear a life jacket.
He insisted that no visitor had entered the room after midnight.
Almost any child can learn to swim with a good teacher.
